keyframe_review.note: 555-560: 0.62 M km2 against the infobox's 1.5 M km2 for 557 (ratio 0.41, beyond a factor of two). The infobox figure looks inflated (the 561 shape, 0.84 M km2, is nearer a count of the provinces named); the shape itself lacks the Yangtze-Huai strip (about 0.27 M km2, all inside Liang's 554 shape) that the Chen page says the Qi held at 557 ('The Qi held the north of the Yangtze'), and that Cliopatria adds only in 561. Corrected by adding the strip.

561-568: 0.84 M km2, the 555 shape plus the Yangtze-Huai strip; consistent with the Chen page's 'The Qi held the north of the Yangtze'. No page opened dates the move, so the 555 verdict carries the strip back to 550.

Shape unchanged for 569-572 only. The Chen's 573 campaign ('gained most of the territory between the Yangtze River and the Huai River'; Shouyang captured in 573 with the Qi commander Wang Lin killed) removes the strip from 573, but Cliopatria keeps the 0.84 M km2 shape to 576.

wars.note: The Chen state itself dates from 16 November 557; in these years the opponents are Wang Sengbian and Chen Baxian's Liang forces.

notes:
CLIOPATRIA ROW. The row (555-576) starts five years after the state (9 June 550) and ends before it (28 February 577): 550-554 uses the last Eastern Wei shape, 577 is covered by the new keyframe northern-qi_573. Wikidata Q1143524 is shared with Cliopatria's 'Qi' (Qi (state), -1046..-204); they are different states and this dossier covers only the Name 'Northern Qi'; the old Qi has its own dossier (qi). The Yangtze-Huai strip is approximated from Cliopatria's own 555-to-561 difference (the 561 increment, all inside Liang's 554 shape).
AREA. Infobox 1.5 M km2 in 557 against 0.62 M km2 (555 shape) or 0.84 M km2 (561 shape): the infobox is probably inflated; the shapes are kept.
NOT ON THE PAGES OPENED. The Northern Qi page (thin on events) has nothing on the Rouran, Khitan, Kumo Xi or the Shanyue, on the 552-554 Liang wars beyond the Chen page's one line, on the fall of Jinyang by month, or on provinces; the Great Wall works of 552 (Lishi to Shuoxian), 555 (1.8 million men), 557 and 563 are dated but not territorial. Gao Shaoyi was handed to the Zhou by the Tujue on 27 July 580 and exiled to Sichuan; Gao Yanzong's claim 'around the new year 577' was short. No Northern Qi vassals or tributaries are on the pages.
PAGE BUDGET. Northern Qi, Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou, plus the shared Chen dynasty and Northern Zhou pages.
